result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one clear defect stands out: an unresolved localization key is displayed as a section heading instead of translated text.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated title (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for 'home_feed.popular_title' to the locale files and ensure a fallback language string is shown when a key is missing.
